turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep getting calls from the same weird number. Every day at lunch.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sounds like a robocall. You can block it from your recent calls list. Tap the number, then block.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done. But they'll just use another number, won't they?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Often, yes. Most phones also have a setting to silence unknown callers, so anyone not in your contacts goes straight to voicemail.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm. My dentist sometimes calls from a number I don't have

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then save the dentist now. Anyone important who calls from a new number can still leave a message, and you'll see it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, turning it on. Peace at last.
